title_en: I went to the shop to …
title_vi: I went to the shop to … (đi đâu để làm gì – mục đích)
theory_html:
A. to … tells us why a person does something

A. to … cho biết lý do/mục đích

Paula wanted a newspaper, so she went to the shop. Why did she go to the shop? To get a newspaper. She went to the shop to get a newspaper.

Paula muốn mua báo, nên cô ấy ra cửa hàng. Tại sao cô ấy ra cửa hàng? Để mua báo. Cô ấy ra cửa hàng để mua báo.

to … (to get / to see etc.) tells us why a person does something:

to … (to get / to see v.v.) cho biết tại sao một người làm việc gì đó:

  • ‘Why are you going out?’ ‘To buy some food.’

    ‘Sao bạn ra ngoài?’ ‘Để mua đồ ăn.’

  • Catherine went to the station to meet her friend.

    Catherine ra ga để đón bạn.

  • Sue turned on the television to watch the news.

    Sue bật TV để xem thời sự.

  • I’d like to go to Spain to learn Spanish.

    Tôi muốn sang Tây Ban Nha để học tiếng Tây Ban Nha.

money / time to (do something):

money / time to (làm gì):

  • We need some money to buy food.

    Chúng ta cần ít tiền để mua đồ ăn.

  • I haven’t got time to watch television.

    Tôi không có thời gian để xem TV.

B. to … and for …

B. to … và for …

to + verb (to get / to see etc.)
to + động từ		for + noun (for a newspaper / for food etc.)
for + danh từ
I went to the shop to get a newspaper. (not for get)I went to the shop for a newspaper.
They’re going to Brazil to see their friends.They’re going to Brazil for a holiday.
We need some money to buy food.We need some money for food.

C. wait for … / wait to … / wait for … to …

wait for …:

wait for … (đợi ai/cái gì):

  • Please wait for me. / Are you waiting for the bus?

    Làm ơn đợi tôi. / Bạn đang đợi xe buýt à?

wait to (do something):

wait to (đợi để làm gì):

  • Hurry up! I’m waiting to go. / Are you waiting to see the doctor?

    Nhanh lên! Tôi đang đợi để đi. / Bạn đang đợi để gặp bác sĩ à?

wait for (somebody/something) to …:

wait for (ai/cái gì) to … (đợi ai/cái gì làm gì):

  • The lights are red. You have to wait for them to change.

    Đèn đang đỏ. Bạn phải đợi đèn chuyển.

  • Are you waiting for the doctor to come?

    Bạn đang đợi bác sĩ đến à?

  • They’re waiting for the lights to change.

    Họ đang đợi đèn chuyển.

mcq.question: Paula went to the shop ___ a newspaper.
mcq.full: Paula went to the shop to get a newspaper.
mcq.vi: Paula ra cửa hàng để mua báo.

to + infinitive = why somebody does something (purpose); money/time to + infinitive.
to + nguyên mẫu = mục đích (để làm gì); money/time to + nguyên mẫu.

wait for somebody/something; wait to do something; wait for somebody/something to do something.
wait for + ai/cái gì; wait to + làm gì; wait for + ai/cái gì + to + làm gì.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wait for + you + to tell.
mcq.key: ‘Do you know what to do?’ ‘No, I’m waiting ___.’|for you to tell me
